description: Registers the ThunderRAG filter custom action and provides an ingest queue for encrypted email delegation.

functions.name: getIngestQueue
functions.description: Return the current queue of messages awaiting background-script decryption and ingestion. Each item has {id, headerMessageId, endpoint, timestamp}.

functions.name: completeIngestItem
functions.description: Remove a completed or failed item from the ingest queue by its id.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: The queue item id to remove.

functions.name: getAttachmentSaveQueue
functions.description: Return the current queue of messages awaiting background attachment saving. Each item has {id, headerMessageId, directoryPath, timestamp}.

functions.name: completeAttachmentSaveItem
functions.description: Remove a completed or failed attachment-save queue item by its id.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: The attachment-save queue item id to remove.

functions.name: setAttachmentSettings
functions.description: Update Thunderbird-side attachment settings cache from add-on local storage. Accepts a JSON string with filterSyntax, defaultPath, and lazyIgnore.

functions.name: renderAttachmentPathByMessageId
functions.description: Render an attachment path template for a messageId using Thunderbird-side message metadata.

functions.name: describeAttachmentsByMessageId
functions.description: Describe attachments for a message and optionally annotate them against a target directory. Returns descriptor objects with match/ignore/existence flags.

parameters.name: directoryPath
parameters.description: Optional directory path used to compute preferred attachment file paths.

parameters.name: headerMessageId
parameters.description: Optional RFC822 Message-Id header value used for logging.

parameters.name: optionsJson
parameters.description: JSON string controlling matcher, syntax, ignore behavior, and related options.

functions.name: saveAttachmentsByMessageId
functions.description: Save attachments for an already-resolved Thunderbird numeric messageId into the given directory path. Returns {saved, directory, attachments}.

parameters.name: directoryPath
parameters.description: Absolute output directory path where attachments should be saved.

parameters.name: headerMessageId
parameters.description: Optional RFC822 Message-Id header value used for logging.

parameters.name: optionsJson
parameters.description: JSON string controlling matcher, syntax, ignore behavior, selected attachment keys, and save options.

functions.name: openFileManagerForPath
functions.description: Reveal a file or directory in Thunderbird's native file manager integration.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute file or directory path to reveal/open.

functions.name: updateIngestStatusCache
functions.description: Push a JSON-encoded map of headerMessageId → boolean ingestion status to the experiment API's column handler cache.

functions.name: getDecryptedBodyText
functions.description: Use Thunderbird's internal MIME pipeline to extract decrypted body text for an S/MIME or PGP-encrypted message. Returns {body, kind} or null.
